title: Electron Probe Micro Analysis (EPMA) of Heterogeneous Catalyst Pellets in the Petrochemical Industry
content: Heterogeneous catalysts are crucial in the petrochemical refining industry [1]. EPMA (Electron Probe Micro-Analyzer) measurements on catalyst pellets provide vital information about elemental compositions, material phase identifications, and concentration profiles [2]. Although EPMA characterization studies on catalyst pellets exist in the literature [3], a comprehensive review of this approach is still needed.
